business_model_1l: Kaynes Technology India Limited is a leading end-to-end IoT solutions-integrated electronics manufacturing company in India, offering comprehensive capabilities across the entire ESDM value chain from new product design and engineering to manufacturing and lifecycle support.
executive_summary: Kaynes Technology has sustained robust top-line growth with revenues compounding at a 50.5% CAGR to ₹3,626 Cr in FY26, alongside steady derived operating EBITDA margin expansion to 16.0%. However, aggressive operational scaling and capital spending have severely constrained cash generation, leading to a cumulative 5-year CFO of -₹615 Cr (-62.9% CFO/PAT conversion) and a decline in ROCE from 25.0% to 13.0%.
